{{Quote|I will not be contained. I cannot be redeemed. Death is all that remains, and you will not kill me. ''[&hellip;]'' I will not be your trophy. If I must die, I choose how&mdash;and everything dies with me.|The Emperor, speaking through his Voice|audio=VitiateDefinitelyDiesHere.flac|<ref name="Doomsday" />}}
A '''Human''' was used by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]], a host of his [[Immortality/Legends|immortal]] essence, during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Unidentified Emperor's Voice (Voss)|previous Voice]], the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Essence transfer|transferred his consciousness]] to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] and gathered his strength on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], preparing to perform the [[Sith Emperor's ritual|ritual]] of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] that would allow him to consume all life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] foiled his agent's attempts to start the ritual, and the Emperor used the Voice to battle the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] when the Knight confronted the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the depths of the [[Dark Temple]] on Dromund Kaas&mdash;a battle that ended with the Voice's [[Death/Legends|death]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We are again aware of the Voice. Preparations are being made to secure a new host, but the rituals take time.|[[Servant One]] of the Emperor's Hand|<ref name="Voice of Darkness">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Voice of Darkness|Voss}}</ref>}}
In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] was trapped in his current [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]]&mdash;the host body for his [[Immortality/Legends|immortal]] essence&mdash;when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] lured the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruler to the ancient ruins known as the [[Dark Heart]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and his [[Voss (species)|Voss]] host were unable to leave the Dark Heart, as the Ancient Halls of the Dark Heart were built in a way that prevented any Voss from leaving once they entered, and the Sith was forced to fight the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Sel-Makor]] for control of the Voice. However, the newest [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], the Emperor's personal executioner, freed the Emperor by [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Voice, and the Emperor's essence returned to the care of his servants in the organization known as the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]].<ref name="Voice of Darkness" />

[[File:HumanEmperorsVoiceDeath-SWTOR.png|thumb|left|350px|The Emperor leaves his dying Voice.]]
The Hand secured a [[Human/Legends|Human]] for the Emperor to use as his newest Voice, and the Sith ruler [[Essence transfer|took full possession]] of his host on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Now free to continue the preparations for the [[Sith Emperor's ritual|dark side ritual]] by which he would consume all life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Emperor traveled to the Sith edifice known as the [[Dark Temple]] with an escort of Sith and members of the [[Imperial Guard]]. The Emperor then gathered his strength in the Temple's inner chambers, awaiting the moment that he could begin his ritual, but his plans were foiled when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] prevented the Emperor's servants from achieving the mass sacrifice that the Emperor required. From the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tol Braga]], the Hero learned the Emperor's location on Dromund Kaas, and the Knight decided to confront the Sith ruler while he was weakened.<ref name="Doomsday" />

The Hero and a crew of allies infiltrated Dromund Kaas and the Dark Temple while a Republic invasion [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Dromund Kaas operation|attacked]] the Imperial capital, and the Emperor's Voice waited in the Dark Temple's inner chambers as the Knight and the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] fought through the Imperial Guardsmen and Sith defending the Emperor. The Emperor used his Human host to battle the Knight and T7-O1, summoning multiple [[Mind trick/Legends|phantom]] copies of the Voice with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to overwhelm his opponent. However, the battle ultimately saw the Jedi victorious,<ref name="Doomsday" /> and a greatly weakened Emperor relinquished control of the dying Voice&mdash;who had been mortally wounded by the Knight's final [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strike&mdash;in order to return to his true body.<ref name="Absence">{{TORcite|type=message|The Emperor's Absence|Servant One of the Emperor's Hand}}</ref> As a final act of vengeance, the Emperor used the Force to bring down the Dark Temple upon the Hero and T7-O1. As the pair escaped the collapsing building, the Voice's body was consumed by a dark side mist and vaporized into dark side energy.<ref name="Doomsday" />

Around [[3626 BBY]], the likeness of the last Emperor's Voice was [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|recreated]] in the [[Mindscape|mind]] of [[Satele Shan]], representing Tenebrae's persona as Vitiate. He was used by Tenebrae to attempt to restore his dead spirit.<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Echoes of Oblivion|Odessen}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Emperor_lightning_saber.png|thumb|right|180px|The Emperor's Voice]]
The Human had pale white, or grey, wrinkled skin and [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He spoke with the Emperor's own emotionless voice while possessed by the Sith ruler.<ref name="Doomsday" /> As the Voice of the Emperor, the Human's mind was completely subjugated by the Emperor's consciousness, and each of his actions were orchestrated by the Sith.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
As the Emperor's Voice, the Human wielded the Emperor's own immense strength in the Force and was capable of utilizing [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] such as [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and physical illusions.<ref name="Doomsday" />

==Equipment==
The Human Emperor's Voice wore black [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Sith apparel|Sith robes]] and brandished a red-bladed [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a metallic [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]]. The Voice's [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] was overlaid with a gray [[Belt/Legends|belt]], a pair of dark [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], [[Vambrace/Legends|vambraces]], and [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and black armor with metallic plating; with double [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]] sloped over the shoulders, and a black silver-trimmed hood shadowed over the head.<ref name="Doomsday" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|While you silenced Darth Baras, the Jedi attempted the impossible feat of destroying the Emperor. Instead, they merely defeated the Emperor's true Voice. The unexpected blow was a shock. The Emperor's consciousness was wrenched from his Voice.|Servant One, in a message to the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="Absence" />}}
[[File:BigBadSithEmperor.png|thumb|250px|right|The Voice's original appearance in the game prior to Echoes of Oblivion.]]
The Human first appeared as "The Emperor" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], in the Jedi Knight-class mission "Doomsday" on Dromund Kaas,<ref name="Doomsday" /> and he is voiced by [[Doug Bradley]].<ref name="Credits">In-game credits for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' list [[Doug Bradley]] as the voice actor for "The Voice of the Emperor."</ref> However, a message from [[Servant One]] of the Emperor's Hand to the [[Sith Warrior]] confirms that the Human whom Jedi Knight players face in "Doomsday" is actually only a Voice of the Emperor, acquired by the Hand after the death of the previous Voice during the Sith Warrior storyline on Voss.<ref name="Absence" /> The Human also appears in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', in pictures of the Hero of Tython's skirmish with the Emperor on Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
